```artifact
Feature: Database and System Design

  Scenario: Database Capacity for 3 Years
    Given a database system
    When the system handles 4.0 Million Consultation requests over 3 years
    Then the database should be designed to accommodate this load

  Scenario: Support for 250,000 Unique Patients
    Given a system designed to handle up to 250,000 unique patients
    When the system provisions 250,000 unique patients
    Then the system should support this number of patients without performance degradation

  Scenario: Support for 5 Specialities
    Given a system designed to support up to 5 specialities
    When the system is configured to include 5 specialities
    Then the system should be able to handle requests for these specialities

  Scenario: Future Growth Considerations
    Given a system designed with future growth in mind
    When the system is scaled up or modified
    Then the system should continue to perform efficiently and meet the requirements

  Scenario: Mobile Platform Compatibility
    Given a system designed to run on a mobile platform
    When the system is tested on an Android device
    Then the system should run smoothly and be accessible on the mobile platform

  Scenario: Adaptive User Interfaces
    Given a system designed with adaptive user interfaces in mind
    When the system is tested on different device screen sizes
    Then the user interface should adapt to the screen size without issues

  Scenario: Usability Perspective
    Given a system designed with usability in mind
    When the system is tested for font sizes and ease of use
    Then the font sizes should be legible and the system should be easy to use
```
